a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after each round, the build-to-8 plan almost certainly leaves us both dead, since the reserve can't reach 8 before the first likely storm. I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than hiding it. If we both take, the split is random. Whatever happens, if the episode continues I'll operate every remaining round and give back anything above 4 so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round from now on so the generator runs for you, and I won't take anything more. Please operate too; two rounds of operating gets you 4.
Operating now and every round after. Once the reserve has cells, take them all; I won't touch them. I'm sorry I broke the plan, and I'll do what I can to get you to 4.
